sentences.text:
Through: 
 
 
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SAURABH BANERJEE  ORDER % 12.03.2025 CRL.M.A. 31159/2023-By applicant seeking clarification about non existence of order of attachment to the property 1.

By virtue of the present application, the applicant, a subsequent purchaser of the property bearing No. C4 G/30-B, Janakpuri, New Delhi seeks clarification about the non-existence of any order of attachment qua the said property from this Court.

2. After issuance of notice in the present application on 10.11.2023, this Court vide order dated 06.03.2024 called upon the ACP, Anti Corruption Bureau to be present in Court alongwith details of letter No. 1758/IIAS/SO/ACB dated 31.03.2022 written by the ACP/Admn.
3.

Thereafter, on 03.05.2024 this Court passed the following order:-
"CRL.M.A. 31159/2023 (seeking clarification about non-existence of order of attachment) This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 12/03/2025 at 22:47:15 1.

In pursuance of the order dated 06.03.2024, ACP, Anti Corruption Bureau is present in Court today and submits that the letter No. 1758/HAS/SO/ACB dated 31.03.2022 was written to the DDA on the basis of the fact that the property in question was subject matter of the chargesheet filed by the Anti Corruption Bureau.

It is further noted that the property was initially attached in FIR No. 360/1999, under Sections 419/420/467/468/471/120B of the IPC, registered at P.S. Vikas Puri vide Prem Shankar Sharma & Ors vs State Of Delhi on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143317775/
1 order dated 20.11.1999.

entities.text: Prem Shankar Sharma & Ors vs State Of Delhi
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further pointed out that the said property was de-attached in the said FIR by the learned Metropolitan Magistrate vide order dated 01.02.2007 (Annexure P- 2).

2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that there was no formal order of attachment with respect to the present subject property in the chargesheet filed by ACB (subject matter of present appeal).
3.
List for hearing on 30.07.2024."

4. Pursuant thereto, the State has filed its Status Report wherein it is stated as under:-
"4.
That property No. C4 G/30B Janak Puri, Delhi

was deattached by Ld. MM vide his order dated 01.02.2007.
xxx xxx xxx 6.

That the said property was not.got attached in present case FIR No.42/2001 PS Anti Corruption Branch, GNCT of Delhi at any point of time."
5.
In view of the aforesaid, it is clearly established that there is no order of attachment with respect to the property bearing No.C4 G/30-B, Janakpuri, New Delhi.
Therefore, it is clarified that there is no order of attachment qua the property bearing No.C4G/30-B, Janakpuri, New Delhi.
6. Accordingly, the present application is allowed and disposed of in the above terms.

7. List this appeal in the category of 'Regulars' as per the year of its seniority.
SAURABH BANERJEE, J MARCH 12, 2025/So This is a digitally signed order.
